system.name: MoE-Lightning
system.one_liner: a high-throughput batch-inference system for Mixture-of-Experts LLMs on memory-constrained GPUs

components.name: Token Embedding
components.role: converts the input token into an embedding vector

components.name: Positional Encoding
components.role: added to the token embedding to inject position information

components.name: Add + Layer Norm
components.role: residual add and normalization after Self Attention and after the MoE FFN

components.name: Router
components.role: selects which expert FFN(s) process the current token

components.name: FFN 1
components.role: one expert feed-forward network, not selected for this token

components.name: FFN 2
components.role: the expert feed-forward network selected by the router for this token

components.name: FFN N
components.role: another expert feed-forward network, not selected for this token

components.name: Mixture of Experts Feed-Forward Network
components.role: sparse FFN layer composed of a router and multiple expert FFNs

flows.what: token routed to the selected expert

content.key_idea: Each Transformer layer's feed-forward network is replaced by a sparse Mixture-of-Experts block, where a router sends each token through only one (or few) of many expert FFNs.
content.reading_order: Bottom to top: from Input Token through Token Embedding, Self Attention, and the Mixture-of-Experts FFN block, up to Output Token.

evidence: Figure 2. Architecture of a Mixture of Experts in Large Language Models.

summary: This is a background/tutorial figure explaining the standard Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Transformer architecture that MoE-Lightning targets for efficient inference. An input token flows bottom-up through token embedding plus positional encoding, self-attention with residual add-and-layer-norm, and into an MoE feed-forward block: a router examines the hidden state and, via dashed candidate arrows to every expert FFN, selects one expert (FFN 2, highlighted with a bold arrow and thicker outline) to actually process the token. The expert's output passes through another add-and-layer-norm and a final linear-plus-softmax layer to produce the output token. Pale yellow stacked rectangles behind the main block indicate that this Transformer layer is repeated N times. The figure uses flat pastel color-coding per component type and dashed-versus-bold arrows to visually distinguish routing options from the selected computation path.
summary_zh: 该图是标准 MoE Transformer 架构的背景说明图：token 经嵌入、自注意力后进入混合专家前馈层，路由器以虚线连接所有专家、粗实线标出实际选中的 FFN 2，体现稀疏条件计算。
